evidence.title: React Data Table with Filters — shadcn/ui + TanStack Table | openstatus

name: data-table-filters
summary: React data table with faceted filters, sorting and infinite scroll, shipped as shadcn registry blocks.
description: A React data table built on TanStack Table and shadcn/ui with faceted filters, sorting, infinite scroll and virtualization. It is distributed as shadcn registry blocks you install into your own repo rather than an npm dependency; filtering, faceted counts and cursor pagination run in SQL via Drizzle ORM, with state in nuqs or zustand. Ships docs, recipes, an agent skill and an MCP block.
contains: 15 shadcn registry blocks, each with a docs page and install recipe
faceted filters: checkbox, input, slider and time range
filtering, faceted counts and cursor pagination run in SQL via Drizzle ORM (Postgres/MySQL/SQLite)
recipes: zero-config from JSON, client-side table, 100k+ rows, API endpoint, row actions, AI-queryable
state management via nuqs (URL-based) or zustand (client-side)
MCP server block exposing a query_table tool to AI agents
ships an agent skill, llms.txt / llms-full.txt and raw markdown docs
